goal: One rule for every author (Claude, Codex, Gemini; operator 2026-10-24: keep direct ships, revert on red). When CI on fast-track goes red, the first session that sees it runs `git revert <breaking sha>` and ships within 10 minutes, then files a card for the author's lane with the failing test and log; the author re-ships the fixed change. No forward-patching on trunk. The same text goes once into the rule file all three read (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, CODEX_START.md, GEMINI_START.md point to it). Case: 23426b191 (GEM-BLD-lab-planted-error-trial) added a test that read a lab file, CI red 10-23 19:37 to about 20:09, two forward fixes (794e56d12, 7facabce8) instead of one revert.
title: Red trunk: revert the breaking commit within 10 minutes, fix on a branch (rule text only, no new tool)
